format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <sf-list-timeline id="log" now="2026-10-27T12:00:00+03:00" has-more><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"items": [{"id": "backup", "time": "2026-10-27T11:58:00+03:00", "status": "success", "title": "Копия создана", "actor": "Планировщик", "text": "1,2 ГБ"}, {"id": "update", "time": "2026-10-27T09:05:00+03:00", "icon": "system_update_alt", "title": "Панель обновлена", "href": "#update"}, {"id": "cert", "time": "2026-10-26T18:40:00+03:00", "status": "warning", "title": "Сертификат истекает"}, {"id": "cert", "title": "повтор"}, {"id": "x"}]}</script></sf-list-timeline>

<sf-list-timeline id="flat" group="none" time-format="exact" label="История" now="2026-10-27T12:00:00+03:00"><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"items": [{"id": "a", "time": "2026-10-27T10:15:00+03:00", "title": "Опубликована"}]}</script></sf-list-timeline>

probes.title: events in the host's order under a heading per day («Сегодня», «Вчера»), each day an ordered list named by its heading; an event without an id or a title, or a repeated id, is left out

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#log'); const groups = [...el.querySelectorAll('.sf-list-timeline-group')]; const heads = groups.map((g) => g.querySelector('.sf-list-timeline-day')); const ids = [...el.querySelectorAll('.sf-list-timeline-item')].map((li) => li.dataset.id).join(','); return groups.length === 2 && heads[0].textContent === 'Сегодня' && heads[1].textContent === 'Вчера' && heads[0].getAttribute('role') === 'heading' && heads[0].getAttribute('aria-level') === '3' && groups[0].querySelector('ol').getAttribute('aria-labelledby') === heads[0].id && ids === 'backup,update,cert'; })()

probes.title: relative time, the exact moment as datetime and title; exact time when asked; the status said in words; an icon in place of the dot

steps.check: (() => { const time = document.querySelector('#log [data-id=backup] time'); const flat = document.querySelector('#flat time'); return time.textContent === '2 минуты назад' && time.getAttribute('datetime') === '2026-10-27T08:58:00.000Z' && time.getAttribute('title').includes('2026') && /\d{1,2}:\d{2}/u.test(flat.textContent) && !flat.textContent.includes('назад') && document.querySelector('#log [data-id=backup] .sr-only').textContent === 'Готово: ' && !document.querySelector('#log [data-id=update] .sr-only') && document.querySelector('#log [data-id=update] .sf-list-timeline-icon').textContent === 'system_update_alt' && document.querySelector('#log [data-id=cert] .sf-list-timeline-dot') !== null && document.querySelector('#flat ol').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'История' && !document.querySelector('#flat .sf-list-timeline-day'); })()

probes.title: the connector runs from under one marker to the next; the last event of a day has none

steps.check: (() => { const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('#log .sf-list-timeline-group:first-child .sf-list-timeline-item')]; const line = getComputedStyle(items[0], '::before'); const last = getComputedStyle(items[1], '::before'); const first = items[0].querySelector('.sf-list-timeline-marker').getBoundingClientRect(); const next = items[1].querySelector('.sf-list-timeline-marker').getBoundingClientRect(); const top = items[0].getBoundingClientRect().top + parseFloat(line.top); const bottom = items[0].getBoundingClientRect().bottom - parseFloat(line.bottom); return line.content !== 'none' && last.content === 'none' && Math.abs(top - first.bottom) < 0.5 && Math.abs(bottom - next.top) < 0.5; })()

probes.title: a title with href is a link; its press asks sf-list-timeline-navigate, cancelable
has-more draws «Показать ещё»; its press asks load-more {direction after, after: the last id}; loading makes it busy

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#log'); return el.getAttribute('data-loading') === 'true' && el.querySelector('.sf-list-timeline-more sf-button').hasAttribute('loading') && el.querySelector('.sf-list-timeline-more button').textContent.includes('Загружаем'); })()

probes.title: with no events one quiet line; new events draw the list

steps.check: (() => { const none = document.querySelector('#none'); return none.getAttribute('data-empty') === 'true' && none.querySelector('.sf-list-timeline-quiet').textContent === 'Событий пока нет' && !none.querySelector('ol'); })()
